text: Convert 0xBEEF to binary and to decimal, using the fact that each hex digit is exactly four bits. Give the binary as one sixteen-digit string and the decimal as an integer.
explanation: 1011111011101111 and 48879. This is why hexadecimal exists: each digit maps to exactly four bits with no arithmetic, so a programmer reads bit patterns in hex and never in decimal. The conversion to decimal, by contrast, required four multiplications — which is the point, because decimal and binary share no convenient boundary and hex and binary share one at every digit.
